name: StellarDrive Demo TF Advanced
author: Romalaure
description:
Big content mod: new worlds, stations, building parts and machines. English, French, Spanish (setting Language).

• Worlds: 7 planets around Otrera + the Erebus galaxy (portal), black holes, asteroid fields, abandoned stations, ruins, villages, wrecks, weather
• Resources: titanium, quartz, cryonite, meteorite, uranium, nuclear power, dark matter
• Building: space stations, trading post with merchant, wood/glass/iron parts, furniture, stairs, doors
• Machines: ship computer screens, advanced engines, force fields, battery, portal, research branch
• Pirates (with Arsenal): raids, radars, stealth generator
• In-game wiki: Guide (G). LowPerformance setting for modest PCs

REQUIRED: MelonLoader 0.7.3 + SDModKit
RECOMMENDED: Arsenal (no pirates without it)
TF mod, if used: 0.15+. Every player needs the same version.
